def test_linear1(self):

def test_linear2(self):
        mod = torch.nn.Sequential(
            torch.nn.Linear(8, 8),
            torch.nn.ReLU(),
            torch.nn.Linear(8, 8),
            torch.nn.ReLU(),
            torch.nn.Linear(8, 8),
            torch.nn.ReLU(),
            torch.nn.Linear(8, 8),
            torch.nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.common(
            mod,
            (torch.randn(2, 8),),
            atol=1e-3,
            rtol=0.01,
        )
